title: Opening Rules of the Twin Sand Course
summary: Opens the school's paired sand to a Warrior with duet strikes and mirrored guards ending in the founding twinned collapse.

title: Hawk-Cry Manual of the Basin Sandmaster
summary: Teaches sand timed to a hawk-like cry that unsettles the foe and ends in the school's sandmaster stoop.

title: Treatise of the Azure Sand Sovereign
summary: A treatise on sand ruled as a sovereign rules a realm and gathered into a crown of dust for the field.

title: Book of the Core Sandglass and the Twin Horizons
summary: A book of the Core turned into a sandglass whose sand pours across two horizons in a single collapse.

title: First Oath-Book of the Plateau Sandbearer
summary: Opens the sandbearer's oath to a Warrior with burdens carried and laid on others ending in the school's burden of the plateau.

title: Wind-Sworn Dust Manual
summary: A manual of dust sworn to the wind that scours whoever breaks the pledge and ends in the wind-sworn scour.

title: Canon of the Open Dustfield
summary: A canon of an unwalled field of dust that spreads from the user to the edge of sight and wears all in it.

title: Book of the Oathcore and the Gale Sand
summary: A book of an oath carried in the Core and loosed as sand upon the wind in a single great burst.
